Never optimize for time in app. CLOSED 2026-10-06: lib/analytics/showing-up.ts counts distinct Members a Host marked present in the last 7 days (attended_at in window, attended_by set and not the seat holder, across event_rsvps and event_tickets; guests counted apart by email; self check-ins and the LIVE-803 yes never count). components/admin/showing-up-band.tsx leads /admin/marketing/analytics as the North Star, this week beside the 7 days before; the WAM band is relabelled Verified practice. No regional split yet: production is North County only today. A persisted weekly series is not built here; LIVE-806 (the Thursday cron) is the natural place to log the reading each week.
